firm_data.firm_description: Colucci & Gallaher, P.C. is a law firm providing legal services to privately owned and publicly traded businesses, as well as municipal entities, in the Northeast United States, Upper Midwest and nationwide. The firm's services include business litigation and counseling, corporate law and contracts, insurance defense representation, and personal legal services.
notable_facts: Counsels some of the world's largest and upstate New York's smallest businesses.
Firm attorneys regularly practice in state and federal courts across the country.

email.subject: AI for Colucci & Gallaher, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Anthony,

Colucci & Gallaher has built an impressive practice across Commercial Litigation, Construction Litigation, and Real Estate Transactions since 1997. Given the complexity of managing those practice areas across multiple jurisdictions, I thought you'd want to see what we're building.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into the Northeast. I'd be happy to stop by Buffalo to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
